newsitem.title: USA: Bigmar chairman increases stake to 58 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bigmar chairman increases stake to 58 pct.

text.p: Bigmar Inc on Wednesday said that John Tramontana, chairman of the board, president and chief executive purchased all 1,293,663 shares of Bigmar Common Stock held by Chemholding SA and four individuals.
Chemholding and the four individuals, which Bigmar did not name, were the original stockholders prior to Bigmar's initial public offering in June 1996.
The purchase brings Tramontana's holdings to 2,392,031 shares, or 58.2 percent of the total shares outstanding, the company said.
The shares were purchased in a privately negotiated transaction in Switzerland.
In a statement, Tramontana said, "I purchased the company's common stock, because I strongly believe in our future as one of the leading manufacturers of generic oncology products."
